# Test fixtures

- `signer-test.p12` — a self-signed PKCS#12 test certificate (CN "PDFluent Test Signer", valid to 2126). It signs nothing but test documents. Its password is recorded in `signer-test.json` next to it, and as `P12_PASSWORD` in `../signed_documents_keep_their_signatures.rs`. The S5 UI walk offers it through the canned file dialog and reads the password from the JSON (`scripts/quality/suite/ui_walk_run.mjs`).
- `ui-walk-doc.pdf` — the document the S5 UI walk opens: the golden three-page sample plus a text box (FreeText) and a placed image (Stamp named Image) on page one, so the controls that act on a selected annotation have one. Rebuild with `python3 scripts/quality/suite/make_ui_walk_doc.py`; `tests/ui-walk-document.test.ts` reads it back.
- `form_scripts.pdf` — an AcroForm order form with `qty`, `price` (a format action) and a read-only `total` (a calculate action, qty x price). Generated by `make_form_scripts.py`, not copied from a third party. Used by J-97 (nothing calculates before consent) and J-57 (calculations after consent), and by `form_scripts_consent.rs`.
- `xfa_calc_order.pdf` — a one-page dynamic XFA order form with fields (`quantity`, `unit_price`, `total`, `discount_code`, `broken_hook`) and one read-only field (`internal_ref`). Generated by `make_xfa_calc.py`, not copied from a third party; no datasets packet. Used by J-59 and `xfa_fill_release.rs`.
- `table_report.pdf` — one page: a heading, a sentence and a ruled table (Item, Quantity, Price; three rows). Generated by `make_table_report.py`, not copied from a third party. Used by J-98, J-99 and `structured_export_files.rs`.
- The other PDFs are inputs of the Rust tests that name them.
